## Goal
Build a complete, self-contained **Backup Management** section for the bot's admin panel, following the existing aiogram 3 / SQLite / Arabic-UI architecture exactly. The bot is a basic Telegram bot with an admin panel that is just inline-keyboard menus (no web layer). Everything is admin-side only, activated via buttons, and **requires no restart** to run scheduled backups.

This is a brand-new feature build (not a fix to an existing PR).

## Ground rules (read RULES.md + PRD.md; mirror existing patterns)
- Mirror the **broadcast scheduler** exactly: an FSM for the 'schedule' flow, a -style parser (reuse the one in broadcast.py — do NOT duplicate), a background **sweeper** in a core service, s for admin DMs, boot-time , and shutdown cleanup.
- Mirror **Broadcaster** service layering (core/ may import db + core, never bot/tg). Put the backup engine in .
- Follow all conventions: repository functions in app/db/repositories.py (owner-aware; backups are admin-scoped), append-only migration in app/db/migrations.py, Arabic strings + esc() + HTML in app/bot/texts.py (no emoji in exported texts — see test_texts.py), CallbackData/string-constant admin routing in app/bot/routers/admin/, FSM in app/bot/states.py, config in app/config.py.
- Do NOT touch the existing TMT transfer/accounts/jobs flows.

## Concrete design

### 1. Migration v11 —  table (app/db/migrations.py)
Append  with a  table and indexes, then register (11, _V11) in MIGRATIONS:
- id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, label TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', kind TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'manual' (manual|scheduled|recurring), scheduled_for TEXT (nullable, ISO-8601 UTC), status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' (pending|scheduled|running|completed|failed|cancelled), file_path TEXT, size_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, error TEXT, created_by INTEGER, created_at/started_at/finished_at TEXT.
- CREATE INDEX idx_backups_status ON backups(status); CREATE INDEX idx_backups_scheduled ON backups(status, scheduled_for) WHERE status='scheduled';

### 2. Repository functions (app/db/repositories.py)
- create_backup(db, *, label, kind='manual', scheduled_for=None, admin_id=None) -> int (creates row; if scheduled_for set -> status='scheduled' else 'pending').
- get_backup(db, backup_id) -> dict|None
- list_backups(db, status=None, limit=50) -> list[dict] (newest first)
- list_due_scheduled_backups(db) -> list[dict]  (status='scheduled' AND scheduled_for <= now_iso(), ORDER BY scheduled_for ASC)
- set_backup_status(db, backup_id, status, **counters) with a whitelisted column set {file_path, size_bytes, error, started_at, finished_at, scheduled_for} (mirror set_broadcast_status — raise ValueError on unknown cols).
- count_backups(db, status=None) -> int

### 3. BackupManager service (app/core/backup_manager.py)
Mirrors Broadcaster's lifecycle shape (constructor takes db, config, bus, data_dir; start_sweeper/stop_sweeper/starts a background asyncio task; recover() on boot; shutdown()).
- Constructor: BackupManager(db, config, bus, data_dir). backup dir = data_dir/'backups'. max_workers 1 (backups are serial/IO-bound and lock-step with the DB file — never concurrent).
- create_backup(label, kind='manual', scheduled_for=None, admin_id=None, run_now=False): repo.create_backup(...); if run_now or no scheduled_for → schedule self.run_backup(backup_id) as a task; else rely on sweeper.
- run_backup(backup_id): set running+started_at; make a CONSISTENT ONLINE snapshot of bot.db via the SQLite backup API from a fresh read-only sqlite3.Connection opened on the db file (NOT the aiosqlite live connection) into the target file data/backups/<label>_<ts>.db — run in asyncio.to_thread to avoid blocking the loop. Record size_bytes, file_path, set completed+finished_at. Emit SystemEvent('backup_completed') (or 'backup_failed' with error). Wrap in try/except (RULES §2/§5): on error set failed+error+finished_at, emit 'backup_failed'. Audit log too.
- cancel(backup_id): if status in ('pending','scheduled') → set 'cancelled', emit 'backup_cancelled'; return bool. (Running cannot be cancelled.)
- restore(backup_id, admin_id): verify backup row exists, status='completed', file exists; checkpoint: live_conn PRAGMA wal_checkpoint(TRUNCATE); then open the backup file as source and use source.backup(live_raw) to overwrite the live DB in place (run in asyncio.to_thread), emit 'backup_restored'. Return str status message. (Restore scope = bot.db only; Telethon sessions + master key are separate files in data/ and untouched, so accounts keep working.)
- start_sweeper()/stop_sweeper(): loop every config.backup_sweep_interval promoting due scheduled backups via run_backup; idempotent (no double-run: only act on status='scheduled' with due time).
- recover(): on boot, mark any 'running' backup as failed with error='interrupted by server restart' (mirror JobManager.recover); due scheduled ones will be picked by sweeper.

### 4. System events (app/core/events.py)
Add backup event types to SYSTEM_EVENTS frozenset: backup_started, backup_completed, backup_failed, backup_scheduled, backup_cancelled, backup_restored. Add Arabic labels in app/bot/texts.py notification_event_label map.

### 5. Config (app/config.py)
Add: backup_sweep_interval: int = Field(default=30, ge=5); backup_keep_last: int = Field(default=10, ge=1); notify_on_backup_events: bool = True. Apply retention (delete oldest backup files) at end of each completed run in BackupManager (keep last backup_keep_last by created_at).

### 6. NotificationService gating (app/core/notifications.py)
Add a gate in _config_enabled: backup_* event types → return self._config.notify_on_backup_events.

### 7. Admin callbacks (app/bot/routers/admin/callbacks.py)
Existing BAK/BAK_NEW/BAK_OPEN stay; add: BAK_CANCEL='adm:bak:cancel:', BAK_RESTORE='adm:bak:restore:', BAK_RESTORE_OK='adm:bak:restoreok:', BAK_RUN_NOW='adm:bak:runnow:', BAK_PAGE='adm:bak:p:'.

### 8. Admin keyboards (app/bot/routers/admin/keyboards.py)
- Add '💾 النسخ الاحتياطية' button to admin_menu_kb (row with Settings, or its own row).
- backups_menu_kb(): [جديد نسخة احتياطية, الجدولة, عرض المكتملة, الرجوع]
- backups_list_kb(backups, page, total_pages): paginated rows '› لABEL #id (status)' → BAK_OPEN, plus cancel/re-run-now where allowed, + back.
- backup_detail_kb(backup): [استعادة, تشغيل الآن, إلغاء, رجوع] (only show applicable buttons by status).
- restore_confirm_kb(backup_id): [تأكيد الاستعادة, إلغاء].

### 9. Admin router (app/bot/routers/admin/backups.py) — FULL rewrite
Replace the stub. Handlers (all admin-gated via router):
- cb_backups (C.BAK): dashboard summary (counts by status) + backups_menu_kb.
- cb_backups_new (C.BAK_NEW): open FSM → ask for label (Arabic prompt).
- FSM BackupsFSM.label / BackupsFSM.scheduled_for.
  - After label: present choices 'الآن' (run immediately) / 'جدولة' (schedule) via inline keyboard (BackupsFSM.pick).
- BackupsFSM.pick handler: if 'now' → manager.create_backup(label, kind='manual', run_now=True); if 'schedule' → set state, ask for time string (reuse broadcast._parse_schedule_time via import), on parse fail re-prompt.
- On scheduled_for entered (BackupsFSM.scheduled_for): parse; on ok → create_backup(label, kind='scheduled', scheduled_for=iso); emit 'backup_scheduled'; show confirmation. (No need to import the parser if you reuse broadcast's; import is acceptable within admin package.)
- cb_backup_open (C.BAK_OPEN + id): render detail card via texts.render_backup_card + backup_detail_kb.
- cb_backup_run_now (C.BAK_RUN_NOW + id): for failed/scheduled pending → manager.create_backup(resume...). Simplest: if status in ('failed','cancelled','pending') → run_backup(backup_id) immediately (set running, re-run). 
- cb_backup_cancel (C.BAK_CANCEL + id): manager.cancel(backup_id); re-render detail.
- cb_backup_restore (C.BAK_RESTORE + id): if completed & file exists → render restore_confirm_kb; else toast error.
- cb_backup_restore_ok (C.BAK_RESTORE_OK + id): manager.restore(backup_id, admin_id); safe_edit result; go to dashboard.
- Pagination: cb_backups_page (C.BAK_PAGE + n).

### 10. texts.py additions
Add exported renderers/constants (append to __all__): render_backup_dashboard(counts), render_backup_card(backup), render_backup_list(backups, page, total), plus short prompt constants. No emoji. Use esc() on all user data; glyphs ✓×›=! =. Add notification label Arabic strings for the new backup event types.

### 11. FSM (app/bot/states.py)
Add BackupsFSM(StatesGroup): label = State(); scheduled_for = State().

### 12. Wiring
- app/bot/routers/admin/router.py: backups router already included — fine (no change) but ensure IsAdmin filter applies (it does at router level).
- app/main.py: instantiate BackupManager(db, config, bus, config.data_dir), call recover() before building dispatcher, start_sweeper(); pass backups=manager into build_dispatcher(...). In finally: stop_sweeper() + await shutdown().
- app/bot/__init__.py (build_dispatcher): accept backups: BackupManager | None = None; dp['backups'] = backups.

## Tests
- tests/test_backups_db.py: migration v11 creates backups table + indexes + columns; repo create/get/list/set_status/list_due_scheduled/cancel flows; set_backup_status rejects unknown cols.
- tests/test_backup_manager.py: with the  fixture + tmp backup dir — create_backup(run_now=True) writes a real .db file containing the users/jobs tables; scheduled backup with past scheduled_for is picked up by the sweeper (call run_backup) → completed + file present; cancel works for scheduled; restore overwrites live db (add a row after backup, restore, row gone) and keeps sessions unaffected; retention removes oldest beyond keep_last.

## Definition of done
-  imports cleanly (type hints everywhere).
-  passes offline (existing + new tests).
- Admin menu gets a '💾 النسخ الاحتياطية' button; the old stub message is replaced by full functionality.
- No breaking changes to transfer/accounts/jobs flows.
